name: Caro Bot STARDUST 15x19

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      runtime_hours:
        description: 'Runtime (hours)'
        required: false
        default: '5.9'
        type: string
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 3 * * *'

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: caro-bot-gamevh-account
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  run-bot-stardust:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 370

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Install Wine (for Stardust Windows exe)
        run: |
          sudo dpkg --add-architecture i386
          sudo apt-get update -qq
          sudo apt-get install -y -qq wine wine32 wine64 xvfb 2>/dev/null || echo "Wine partial install, continuing..."
          wine --version || echo "Wine not found but continuing"

      - name: Install Python dependencies
        run: pip install websockets requests --break-system-packages

      - name: Run STARDUST Caro Bot
        env:
          CARO_USER: ${{ secrets.CARO_USER }}
          CARO_PASSWD: ${{ secrets.CARO_PASSWD }}
          CARO_RUNTIME_HOURS: ${{ github.event.inputs.runtime_hours || '5.9' }}
        run: python3 STARDUST.py

      - name: Show match statistics
        if: always()
        run: |
          if [ -f /tmp/caro_ag_stats.json ]; then
            cat /tmp/caro_ag_stats.json
          else
            echo "No statistics file was produced."
          fi
